layout.$description: Page layout spacing that changes by screen class: compact under 600px, medium 600 to 839px, expanded 840px and up (Material 3 window size classes). Rules (tested): every value is a step on the space scale, and a smaller screen never gets more space. Big spaces shrink on phones; spacing inside components never changes.

gutter.$description: Space between the page edge and content.

section.$description: Space between major sections of a page.

content-max.$description: Max content width: the widest a page's content gets, in every product. Wider screens get more space at the sides, not wider content. Running text has its own, narrower cap (type.measure). 1024px is the US Web Design System's default container (Decisions, Oct 7). Shared for now; a product can get its own later.

title-gap.$description: Space under a page title, before the page's first content.
